The greatest common factor (GCF) of 6432 and 132 is found by prime factorization or the Euclidean algorithm.

- 132 factors into \(2^2 \times 3 \times 11\).
- 6432 factors into \(2^5 \times 3 \times 67\).
- The common prime factors are \(2^2\) and \(3\), so GCF = \(4 \times 3 = 12\).

Increasing this GCF by 11 gives \(12 + 11 = 23\).

Answer: 23
